title: Auto-Renew Loyalty Credit on Price-Matched Manual Renewals — Domain Registrations
content:
Domain Registrations domains that keep auto-renew switched on earn the manual line's autopay credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits of a manual renewal charge on that domain.

## Terms

The manual line's autopay credit is **USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered** where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match; **USD 0.20 for each year the charge covered** where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded; and **nothing** where auto-renew is off.

## Truth table

| Auto-renew setting on the domain | Declined auto-renew attempt recorded on the domain less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match | Autopay credit |
|---|---|---|
| on | none | USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered |
| on | one or more | USD 0.20 for each year the charge covered |
| off | any | nothing |

## Notes on reading the records

- The declined attempts that count are those recorded on this domain; declines on other domains of the account are not this domain's history.
- A declined attempt recorded 12 whole months or more before the day of the price match no longer counts. With a hypothetical price match on 2 May 2029, a decline recorded on 3 May 2028 is 11 whole months back and counts, while a decline recorded on 2 May 2028 is 12 whole months back and does not.
- One declined attempt is enough for the lower rate; several declines earn the same USD 0.20.

## Hypothetical example

Auto-renew on, one decline recorded 5 whole months before the price match, manual renewal charge covering 2 years: twice USD 0.20, that is USD 0.40.
